description: Vermont licensed center metadata and aggregate preflight only; no provider records.

output_schema_contract.scope: license_type='Licensed Provider' AND provider_program_type IN('CBCCPP','CBCCPP - Non-Recurring')
output_schema_contract.row_unit: source licensed-center cohort rows, not unique active businesses
output_schema_contract.reporting_period: One reporting file required; no date inferred from filename
output_schema_contract.coordinates: Excluded from future selected projection; publisher coordinates are jittered, not exact geocodes

redirect_policy: Fixed SODA v3 query.json and catalog URLs; reject redirects, omit credentials.
retry: No retries or legacy endpoint fallback.
checkpoint: Complete paired sanitized metadata/group/count observations only; cached values discarded.
idempotency: Immutable UUID receipt; no overwrite or current pointer.
cancellation: Abort pacing/headers/body; await writer and retain ambiguous committed receipt for inspection.
retention_profile: Internal sanitized metadata and aggregates only.
